items.title: Show HN: Agent Chaperone – Screen AI agent tool calls and results with Jev
items.contentSnippet:
Hi everyone.
TypeSafe released Jev last week, and it pushed me to build agent-chaperone. It is a screening layer for AI agent tool calls and tool results.
It screens risky, off-task, or secret-leaking actions before they run, and prompt injections or other suspicious instructions before the agent reads them.

items.contentSnippet: At, GPTree, we run several coding agents across our team on one repo using parallel worktrees. items.title: What Makes Dual Enrollment Actually Work: Robust Student & Family Support & Career Connection
items.contentSnippet: The third installment in our four-part series with Britebound moves beyond course design to ask a harder question: who is responsible when a student struggles? This post makes the case that robust dual enrollment requires named staff, early drop windows, family scaffolding, and mentors who open doors to careers students have never had reason to imagine. For district leaders building or scaling concurrent enrollment programs, this is the support infrastructure blueprint you have been looking for.
